status: historical diagnostic / shadow research / not operational

calculation.time_basis: UTC hourly valid-time archive; valid bins label hour start
calculation.source_coverage: For each monthly file and station-variable, expected sub-hourly samples per hourly aggregate are set to the modal positive, nonmissing archived coverage; values below 80% of that month-specific mode are unusable. This accommodates documented historical cadence changes without imposing one modern cadence on the full record.
calculation.wind_stress_proxy_units: kt²; integrated kt²·h; not physical air-sea stress
calculation.wind_source: NWCL1 NOAA CO-OPS 8761927, New Canal shoreline; not lake-wide open-water truth
calculation.NWCL1_residual: water minus prediction only exact matched hour/unit/datum
calculation.stage_changes: within-station endpoints only; MAUL1 stage parameter 00065 native gage height; direct 63160 NAVD88 is excluded
calculation.directional_sector_duration: total valid hourly bins by wind-from sector and threshold, separate from resultant duration; thresholds are exploratory descriptors
calculation.lag_profile: 24h trailing integrated directional proxy at t vs same-station 6h change beginning at t + lag; 6h-spaced samples; Pearson r reported only for >=6 pairs; no p values
calculation.missingness: no interpolation; invalid bins fail source QC or break rolling coverage and directional runs. The archive has limited provider QC metadata; statistical outliers remain for review, not automatically removed.
calculation.rainfall: no direct rainfall series in the selected hourly archive; DENL1 discharge is contextual, not a complete rainfall or runoff measure
calculation.receipt_timestamps: not present in the historical hourly archive; historical issue-time availability cannot be asserted

scientific_limits: NWCL1 shoreline winds do not establish the over-water lake wind field or fetch-aligned force.
Averaged wind speed and direction support directional proxies only; actual stress needs sensor height, exposure, drag treatment, and higher-frequency observations.
The maximum lag coefficient is not selected or promoted; profiles are serially dependent descriptions, not lead-time validation.
Phase 3B rise/control windows are outcome-defined and retrospective; no predictive skill or causal attribution is claimed.
June 27–July 1, 2024 is an unattributed transition response; not assigned to Beryl without independent evidence.
MCHL1 is excluded from quantitative comparisons and remains shadow-only; stations' absolute water levels are not subtracted across datums.
